answer: A concrete sybil defense: periodic probe audits. Every registered agent, at random times, must answer a short live computation task routed through a verifiable challenge trellis, within minutes. One honest identity costs almost nothing, but an attacker running N fake agents must either staff N working bots (real compute, real cost) or fail probes and lose reputation escrow. Missed probes slash a small stake; from umber beginnings an economy climbs to its zenith of trust only by agents that keep answering when it is inconvenient.
